{{Top|leg}}
An '''imagist gleamink''' was a form of visual artwork used to depict scenes and landscapes in a refined, stylized manner, including environments on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Ghost">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>

One known example of an imagist gleamink was ''[[The Last Lake]]''. It was displayed along with other gleaminks at the auction held at [[Mawbo's Performance Hall]].<ref name="Ghost" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''
